name: breathe
description: A short breathing exercise beside the chat: /breathe, on a schedule, or when your prompts run hot.

where.title: Where it opens
where.description: pane: beside the chat, at once. window: a small Edge window on top of everything, bottom-right (Windows). A pane that cannot be placed (a narrow terminal, a scheduled break) opens the window instead.

pattern.title: Breathing pattern
pattern.description: 4-6: in 4 s, out 6 s. box: in, hold, out, hold, 4 s each. 4-7-8: in 4, hold 7, out 8.

length.title: Length
length.description: How long the window breathes before it closes itself.

sound.title: Sound
sound.description: A low drone that swells with each breath. Off: silent.

schedule.title: Scheduled break
schedule.description: Open the window this often while Claude Code is open.

anger.title: Hot prompts
anger.description: When your prompts run hot. open: the window opens by itself (it never takes the keyboard). hint: a status-line hint to run /breathe. off: never.

sensitivity.title: Hot prompts: sensitivity
sensitivity.description: How much heat opens it. high: a couple of frustrated prompts. normal: a run of them, or one very heated. low: a real meltdown. Casual swearing never counts; swearing at Claude or at what broke does. /breathe heat shows where you are.

cooldown.title: Hot prompts: cooldown
cooldown.description: At most one hot-prompt window or hint in this long, across sessions.
